arguments.prompt:
Create ONE reusable static character BODY BASE for SoloGym. This is body-preset authoring, not equipment generation. A single adult character, full body, EXACT straight frontal orthographic-like view: face, sternum, pelvis and both knees point directly at the viewer; no three-quarter turn, no tilt, no perspective foreshortening. Neutral balanced standing pose, relaxed arms slightly clear of the torso, hands at upper-thigh height, fingers naturally curled and thumbs inward. Both hands and feet are fully visible, separate from each other and the torso. Feet planted about hip-width apart on one level baseline. Neutral confident facial expression, nonsexual catalog presentation.
Maintain the established polished manhwa game-illustration style: crisp dark contours, clean painted cel shading, warm medium tan skin, coherent anatomy and uncluttered material shapes. Keep the same face and hairstyle as the identity reference. Body-type changes alter the silhouette, not age, ethnicity, skin tone or identity. The character is an adult around 25-30 years old.
Canvas/composition: one square 1024x1024 image, centered around x=512, hair top about y=65 and sole baseline about y=955, equal height for all body presets, safe margin around every finger/toe. Plain uniform white background. No cast shadow, vignette, gradients in the background, floor, props, panels, labels, text or UI. One person only, not a comparison sheet. BARE FEET with anatomically clear toes, bare ankles and BARE HANDS/wrists. No wrist wraps, hand bandages, gloves, rings, headband, shoes, socks, boots, weapons, backpack, straps, belt, jacket or decorative accessories. No glow, animation or effects. Natural bodily proportions and neutral lighting, no exaggerated crotch or chest contouring.
IDENTITY: Adult male with short spiky black hair, strong straight brows, brown eyes and Kai-like angular clean-shaven face. The source may be a comparison board: use ONLY the leftmost adult male as the identity reference and output ONE frontal person; discard every other panel and all equipment.
TARGET BODY: Medium ordinary build: moderate chest and shoulders, naturally soft waist and slightly soft belly, normal arms and legs. No visible six-pack and no bodybuilder definition.
BASE GARMENT EXCEPTION: he wears ONLY plain opaque charcoal boxer briefs/short boxer trunks, short legs to the upper thigh, simple thin waistband at the natural low waist, no logo, fly emphasis, ornament or loose long fabric. Shirtless upper body. Bottoms cover the groin and buttocks fully, not briefs or thong. No top of any kind.
Do not keep any extra clothing or equipment from the reference. The image is the single static frontal body base with only the specified minimal garments.
arguments.name: Base Male Medium R1
